summary.content:
Today's selection covers 81 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Adds Another $12 Billion to Latest Funding Round
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Okta’s CEO is betting big on AI agent identity
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 50 articles published in the last 24 hours
